WITH player_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS player_id,
        p.player_fifa_api_id,
        p.player_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        MAX(p.weight) AS max_weight,
        SUM(p.player_fifa_api_id) AS total_fifa_api_id
    FROM Player p
    GROUP BY p.player_fifa_api_id, p.player_api_id
    HAVING MAX(p.weight) > 0
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT 
        ta.player_fifa_api_id,
        ta.player_api_id,
        ta.player_name,
        ta.player_fi_a_api_id,
        ta.finishing_rate,
        ta.curve_score
    FROM Player_Attributes ta
    JOIN Player p ON ta.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE ta.player_fifa_api_id = (
        SELECT MAX(p.weight)
        FROM Player p2
        WHERE p2.player_fifa_api_id = ta.player_fifa_api_id
    )
),
final_final AS (
    SELECT 
        fi.player_fifa_api_id,
        fi.player_api_id,
        fi.player_name,
        fi.fifa_fi_a_api_id,
        fi.finishing_rate,
        fi.curve_score
    FROM final_final fi
)

WITH player_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS player_id,
        p.player_fifa_api_id,
        p.player_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        MAX(p.weight) AS max_weight,
        SUM(p.player_fifa_api_id) AS total_fifa_api_id
    FROM Player p
    GROUP BY p.player_fifa_api_id, p.player_api_id
    HAVING MAX(p.weight) > 0
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT 
        ta.player_fifa_api_id,
        ta.player_api_id,
        ta.player_name,
        ta.player_fi_a_api_id,
        ta.finishing_rate,
        ta.curve_score
    FROM Player_Attributes ta
    JOIN Player p ON ta.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE ta.player_fifa_api_id = (
        SELECT MAX(p.weight)
        FROM Player p2
        WHERE p2.player_fifa_api_id = ta.player_fifa_api_id
    )
),
final_final AS (
    SELECT 
        fi.player_fifa_api_id,
        fi.player_api_id,
        fi.player_name,
        fi.fifa_fi_a_api_id,
        fi.finishing_rate,
        fi.curve_score
    FROM final_final fi
)
SELECT * FROM final_final ORDER BY fi.player_fifa_api_id;
```

ORDER BY s.id;

FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON f.CDS = sa.CDS
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 400
GROUP BY s.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.CDSCode;
```

FROM frpm f
